name: Qwen3 Embedding
summary: Qwen3 Embedding is an open-weight series of text embedding models from Alibaba's Qwen team, built on Qwen3 and released in June 2025 in 0.6B, 4B and 8B sizes, with matching Qwen3-Reranker models. The models accept task instructions, support 100+ natural and programming languages, and can be run locally or through hosted APIs.
goodFor: Self-hosted embeddings with no per-token fees
Choosing a size to fit local hardware
watchOut: Self-hosting means running your own inference stack
Leaderboard rank is a June 2025 snapshot
Instructions should be added to queries for best results
